issues.on_page: Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (report p8; trimmed pages are report pp5, 6, 7, 20)
issues.issue: The governmental funds operating statement wasn't trimmed, so a GAAP-basis report has no revenue lines by source, no GAAP expenditures, no beginning fund balance and no transfers. Receipts and disbursements come from the budget-basis schedule instead. The PDF needs re-trimming (the extractor's decision_needed already raises this).

The single line combines receipts and transfers but is recorded as revenue, category other. reported_totals includes ['transfers_in'] while transfers_in is null. The Statement of Activities (p2) shows revenues of 1,202,552 (charges 290,139, capital grants 763,940, property tax 141,041, misc 7,432); the 42,457 difference may be interfund transfers counted as receipts. Capital grants are more than half, so 'other' may not be the best category, but the budget line itself isn't broken down.

issues.on_page: Budgetary Comparison Schedule: Receipts and transfers (resource inflows) actual 1,245,009, budget 1,300,853
issues.issue: The schedule's expenditure lines are in detail[], but its receipts line isn't (no revenue detail or detail_totals entry). It is in receipts[], so it's arguably left out on purpose because it mixes transfers.

Printed as budgetary fund balance, not cash. Treating it as beginning cash relies on the budgetary ending balance equalling cash (344,293 = cash on p4 reconciliation), which is a fair assumption but still an assumption.

issues.on_page: Statement of Net Position - Governmental Activities column only
issues.issue: The extractor rules list airport authorities as entirely business-type, but this report presents only governmental activities and governmental funds. Recording it as governmental follows the statements and is defensible; noting the conflict for the user.
